text:
yuki (data): Hey team — quick ask. I had an unexpected medical procedure in Dec and couldn't use ~48h of PTO during the year-end blackout (Dec 24-31). I filed FMLA paperwork but wonder if we can carry over 48 hours instead of the 40h cap. Need those days for followup in Jan.

zoe (People Ops): Sorry to hear that, @yuki. For carryover >40h we require a documented exception. Medical reasons are a valid basis, but we need HR sign-off plus a short audit note.

anita (HR): Confirm: we'll need a medical note or FMLA confirmation on file. Also confirm that the unused hours were pre-approved PTO (not unpaid leave). If so, HR can recommend an exception to payroll.

paul (Payroll): FYI payroll cutoff for year-end carry/payout decisions is Dec 31 23:59 UTC. If approval happens after that cutoff we can still record a carryover exception but the payout/ledger will reflect in next cycle.

samir (Eng Manager): From a coverage perspective, Jan sprint planning is light for Yuki's subteam. I'm ok supporting the extra carryover if HR+People Ops approve. Will post an `approved` message here once docs are uploaded.

leah (Legal): Quick privacy note: any medical documentation should be shared only with HR (anita) via secure HR intake (do not post in Slack). People Ops can reference the approval in public channels but not include PHI.

yuki (data): I've uploaded FMLA confirmation to the HR intake portal and emailed @anita the case ID. I wasn't on unpaid leave — PTO was previously approved but blocked by the shutdown.

anita (HR): Got it, Yuki. I have the intake. I'll review and flag for an exception recommendation. Expect a reply in 48hrs.

zoe (People Ops): Process reminder: exceptions for carryover >40h require (1) HR verification of medical documentation, (2) manager `approved` reply in this thread for audit, and (3) People Ops logging the exception with payroll.

paul (Payroll): Once HR endorses, I'll update the PTO ledger and schedule the carryover effective Jan payroll. No immediate payout required. If you need payout instead, Yuki, file a separate payroll request.

samir (Eng Manager): approved — Samir.

zoe (People Ops): Thanks. Anita, please post endorsement here when ready and I'll file the exception record. Tagging @paul for ledger update.

anita (HR): Endorsement: HR confirms FMLA doc received and validates that PTO was pre-approved and unusable during shutdown. Recommending carryover exception for 48h. (Details sent to payroll via secure channel).

paul (Payroll): Noted. I'll add 48h carryover to Yuki's ledger for Jan payroll processing.

zoe (People Ops): Exception logged and audit note created. Closing thread — reopening if anything changes. Thanks all!

time-off-bot: PTO ledger updated for yuki (48h carryover) at 2191242000
